title: Gideon and the Compass
author: Astrid Fairweather
blurb: Ivo Kavanagh, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the ice breaks on the river.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
